name: Diferencia de Valores de Píxel
description: Detecta patrones de diferenciación de valores de píxeles tipo esteganografía que se filtran en imágenes generadas por IA (Wu & Tsai).
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Pixel Value Differencing
mechanism:
Este método applies Pixel Value Differencing (PVD) analysis following Wu & Tsai (2003) for steganographic and manipulation detection:

1. **Bloque Partitioning**: The image is divided into non-overlapping blocks of two consecutive pixels. For each block, the difference value dₖ = |pᵢ − pᵢ₊₁| is computed between adjacent pixel pairs in both horizontal and vertical directions.

2. **Difference Histograma Construction**: A histogram of all pixel difference values is constructed. Natural images exhibit a characteristic PVD histogram following a Laplacian-like distribution — high concentration near zero (smooth regions) with exponential decay toward larger differences (edge regions).

3. **Range Table Análisis**: Differences are classified into ranges [lₖ, uₖ] following the PVD range table. Each range has an expected capacity proportional to its width. Steganographic embedding modifies the histogram within these ranges in detectable ways — creating artifacts in the distribution tails.

4. **Estadístico Regularity Detección**: El método detects statistical anomalies in the PVD histogram: (a) unnatural steps between adjacent bins caused by embedding algorithms, (b) abnormal symmetry or flatness in típicamente peaked distributions, (c) deviations from the expected Benford-like first-digit distribution of differences.

5. **AI Generation Indicators**: generado por IA images típicamente exhibit PVD histograms with abnormal smoothness (lacking the fine-grained irregularities of real camera quantization), unusual uniformity across difference ranges, or artificial periodicity absent in natural pixel statistics. The analysis score quantifies these deviations.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos

references.title: Wu, D.C. & Tsai, W.H. (2003). A Steganographic Method for Images by Pixel-Value Differencing. Pattern Recognition Letters.
Fridrich, J. et al. (2001). Detecting LSB Steganography in Color and Gray-Scale Images. IEEE Multimedia.
